info.name: Giggy Speech API
info.description:
# Giggy Speech API — text-to-speech and recorded transcription

Build voiceovers, spoken notifications, and transcription workflows. Free Batch TTS returns completed MP3 audio; free Batch STT accepts recordings up to 60 seconds. Both are queued. Fast TTS is explicitly paid.

## Generate your first audio
1. Create your own API key at https://giggy.ai. Fork this collection and set `GIGGY_API_KEY` in a private environment. Never publish the key.
2. Send **Find English voices**. On success its script selects the first returned `voice_id` into the collection's `voiceId` variable. You can choose another returned ID yourself.
3. Edit `sampleText`, then send **Free Batch TTS**. Check HTTP 200 and `audio/mpeg`; use Send and Download or Save Response to save `speech.mp3`. Queued requests may take up to 600 seconds.
4. **Fast TTS (Paid)** uses credits and higher queue priority. It is optional; do not run the whole collection unless you intend paid usage.

## Transcribe a recording
1. Download `sample-recording.wav` from https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-examples/tree/main/postman or supply your own authorized WAV (PCM16 LE, mono, 16 kHz, 0.5–60 seconds for Batch).
2. Open **Transcribe recording — Free Batch** → Body → binary and select the local WAV. Use the Desktop Agent if your browser agent cannot upload files.
3. HTTP 202 is admission, not a completed transcript. The script stores `generationUuid` from the response.
4. Send **Check transcript status** until completed. Its script stores the signed `transcriptUrl`. On failure, inspect the error; do not resubmit while queued or processing.
5. Send **Download completed transcript** only after completion. This request has no API-key header because the signed URL is the authorization. Treat the URL as private; do not share your environment or results.

Recorded STT is distinct from live microphone transcription. Batch is free but subject to queues, request-size limits, and rate limits. Fast and Streaming have separate pricing. Error responses are JSON; do not save them as audio. STT does not provide speaker diarization, word timestamps, sentiment, or PII redaction.

## Agent workflows
Use the separate [**Giggy Speech MCP**](https://www.postman.com/giggy-ai/giggy-speech-api/collection/6ace9f50d5652f476d274389) collection to connect to the existing remote Streamable HTTP endpoint `https://giggy.ai/mcp`. Authenticate with your own key using `Authorization: Bearer`.

## Developer resources
- [Speech API docs](https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api)
- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.giggy.ai/v1/openapi.json)
- [Free Batch Python tutorial](https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-examples/tree/main/python/basic-tts)
- [Giggy MCP setup](https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-mcp)
- [Python SDK](https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-python)
- [JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/giggy-ai/giggy-js)

request.description: Lists public English voices. On HTTP 200 the script selects the first returned voice_id for the TTS requests. Replace voiceId with another returned ID to choose a different voice.

exec: pm.test("At least one voice is available", () => pm.expect(data.voices).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty);

request.description: Batch is free but queued and subject to request-size and rate limits. Set GIGGY_API_KEY in your private Postman environment; never store or share it in this collection. Run Find English voices first, or set voiceId to a returned voice_id. The request waits for completed audio/mpeg; no polling is required. Use Send and Download (or Save Response to a file) and save the response as speech.mp3. Check for HTTP 200 and audio/mpeg before saving; errors are JSON. Allow up to 600 seconds for queued generation. Documentation: https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api

Fast consumes credits and receives higher queue priority. Set GIGGY_API_KEY in your private Postman environment; never store or share it in this collection. Run Find English voices first, or set voiceId to a returned voice_id. The request waits for completed audio/mpeg; no polling is required. Use Send and Download (or Save Response to a file) and save the response as speech.mp3. Check for HTTP 200 and audio/mpeg before saving; errors are JSON. Allow up to 600 seconds for queued generation. Documentation: https://giggy.ai/docs/speech-api

Select sample-recording.wav or your own authorized WAV in Body → binary. PCM16 LE mono 16 kHz, 0.5–60 seconds. Batch uses zero credits. HTTP 202 only admits the recording; then use Check transcript status. Do not resubmit while queued or processing. Remove language for automatic detection.
Read the admitted recording status. Repeat this GET while queued or processing; do not create another transcription. Only completed status with result.url enables Download completed transcript.
Run only after Check transcript status reports completed. The signed URL is private and already authorizes this request; never attach your Giggy API key to it.
